## Decisions Made

- **CLI design:** single switch/case in `main.go` — no external CLI framework (no cobra/urfave needed; keeps deps minimal)
- **`internal/core/runner.go`:** thin orchestrator — delegates to existing internal packages, not reimplementing logic
- **`lifecycle.go` Bootstrap():** idempotent — never overwrites existing files, safe to call every startup
- **Session memory format:** `session-{YYYYMMDD-HHmmss}-{8hexchars}.md` — sortable by timestamp, globally unique
- **Platform detection order:** GitHub → GitLab → CircleCI → Bitbucket → Jenkins → Azure → Travis → TeamCity → Drone → Claude → Gemini → Generic CI → Standalone

## Lessons Learned

- The old `runner.go` had stale content even after `edit` — use `cat >` heredoc for clean overwrite
- `planning` package uses free functions (`ScanRepo`, `GeneratePlan`) not a struct — match existing API before writing callers
- `changelog.Writer.Append()` signature: `(category, summary, detail, runID string)` — not an `Add(Entry)` method
- Always check actual package APIs with `grep "^func"` before writing callers in new packages
